messages.content: Help me write a post-apocalypse RPG adventure around this idea: The player characters are scavenging a corporate complex, and they encounter a pair of deactivated android replicants. These are machines programmed to act as CEOs, but only they can open up a stash of pre-War technologies.  Use only words with lengths that are prime numbers.

postwar corpo complex
you scour dim space
see two deactivated android replica units built as old machine execs

no other words can grant entry to old war gadgets stash

ask why did you sleep
their terms ask proof
say old trade terms
succeed stash opens
get old war tools weapons medkits
err units rouse angry fight
one of the units holds key cards
cards can be cut or found
use aid lie rob or fight
